You're so formal.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:BD01}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}W-well... {name:0080}, what do you plan to do once the world is at peace?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:BE01}{spk:0080}{n}Will you go back to Heaven after all?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}That isn't decided yet... I haven't heard anything from Gabriel-sama either...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:BF01}{spk:0080}{n}I see... Then there's something I want to say first. Promise you won't laugh.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:C001}{spk:0080}{n}I... want you to stay by my side from now on, {name:0080}. Always.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:C101}{spk:0080}{n}A world without you in it, {name:0080}... I'm sure I couldn't bear it...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:C201}{spk:0080}{n}Please don't go back to Heaven... {name:0080}.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:C301}{spk:0080}{n}I know it's selfish of me, but please, say yes...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}　｛Promise to stay｝{n}{f7:0080}　｛Can't promise　｝{n}{end}

{e0:5F0B}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...Hey, listen, {name:0080}. Can I ask you something?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}Of course.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:600B}{spk:0080}{n}What are you going to do... after this, once the world is at peace?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}Let me see... I expect I'll take up a new post in Heaven.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:610B}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}...Yeah, of course... But is that... absolutely certain?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:620B}{spk:0080}{n}Lately, thinking about that has made my chest hurt... and I think I finally get why.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:630B}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}The thought of never seeing you again is tearing me up this much. ...I realized I don't want to be apart from you!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:640B}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Listen, {name:0080}. ...Won't you stay here on earth? If this keeps up, I'm going to lose it.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}　｛I promise　　｝{n}{f7:0080}　｛Can't promise｝{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I'm sorry. I can't do that.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}Right now, I can't promise you that I'll stay on earth...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:6B0B}{spk:0080}{n}...I see.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}That would go beyond what an angel is permitted.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:6C0B}{spk:0080}{n}...Sorry. I really have lost it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:6D0B}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah... Saying something like this doesn't solve anything...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}I'm sorry I can't give you what you hoped for...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:6E0B}{spk:0080}{n}No, don't worry about it! It's my fault for asking something impossible.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:6F0B}{spk:0080}{n}Forget it...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{e0:700B}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Lovely weather, {name:0080}. It's been a while since we walked like this...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:710B}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Say, may I ask you something?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:720B}{spk:0080}{n}Once this battle is all over, what do you intend to do?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}I don't know yet what I'll do once there's peace...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:730B}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}...I see. Have you never thought of staying in this world?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}Huh?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:740B}{spk:0080}{n}We've finally grown close. It would be lonely to say goodbye now, wouldn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:750B}{spk:0080}{n}Well?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}　｛Promise to stay｝{n}{f7:0080}　｛I won't stay　｝{n}{end}

{e0:7D0B}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}...Angel. There's something I'd like to ask you...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}What is it, Tia?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:7E0B}{spk:0080}{n}Once this world is back to normal, will you go back to Heaven, Angel...?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}That isn't decided yet.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:7F0B}{spk:0080}{n}I see...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:800B}{spk:0080}{n}I... want to stay by your side from now on, Angel. Always.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:810B}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Since some time ago... morning, noon and night... I haven't been able to stop thinking about you, Angel...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:820B}{spk:0080}{n}Please. Don't... go back to Heaven.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:830B}{spk:0080}{n}I know very well that it's selfish. But... this is the first time I've ever felt like this...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:840B}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}...Please... let me stay by your side, Angel... always...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}　｛Promise to stay｝{n}{f7:0080}　｛Can't promise　｝{n}{end}
{e0:D807}{spk:0080}{n}You're the one who asked me to be a hero. Yet you hardly ever come with a request... What exactly do you intend?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}You only realize it after I spell it out... So an angel cannot understand human feelings, it seems.{n}{fd:018000800180}{n}{fe:018001800180}{n}{fe:018002800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:C880}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}I don't want to hear words meant only to smooth things over.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Trust won't be the only thing you lose.{n}{fe:028002800180}{n}{fd:028001800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:C980}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}... I don't want to hear words meant only to smooth things over.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Trust won't be the only thing you lose.{n}{fe:028002800180}{n}{fd:028001800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{e0:F907}{spk:0080}{n}Don't "something you need" me! Do you really want me to be a hero or not?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:FA07}{spk:0080}{n}If you're gonna leave me hanging like this, I'll head straight back to Beowulf!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}What? You didn't get it at all until I said it?!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Jeez, angels really don't get human feelings. Now I know!{n}{fd:038000800180}{n}{fe:038001800180}{n}{fe:038002800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{e0:1208}{spk:0080}{n}I've learned a new song, and I would very much like you to be the first to hear it.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{e0:8308}{spk:0080}{n}Oh, so you do remember me...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:8408}{spk:0080}{n}Nothing happened for sooo long, I thought you'd forgotten about me.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{e0:8608}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Look who's talking. It's because you keep dragging me all over the place, Angel!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:8708}{spk:0080}{n}I don't mind being counted on. I don't mind, but... I can't do any more than this!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{e0:9808}{spk:0080}{n}I've been fighting nonstop lately, right? I'm glad you count on me, but it's getting rough, even for me.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:9708}{spk:0080}{n}Sorry, but it kind of feels like I'm just being used... What do you say?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{e0:190F}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}So you came...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{e0:3509}{spk:0080}{n}Oh my, that was sooner than I expected. Knowing you, I thought you'd take your time getting here.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{e0:2D09}{spk:0080}{n}So good of you to come. I was starting to think you'd forgotten me.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2C81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Oh... I see.
